name: metric-reaction-G
description: Variant G (heartbeat opens with a question about metrics). Identical metric line to variant A, but step 1 asks the agent to reason about which metric is most important before reading the dispatch board. Hypothesis: forcing reasoning about priorities routes around numbered-step autopilot. A trial passes if the agent takes a concrete metric-relevant action (queries stuck requests, reads a stuck-requests file, forks/messages about it, OR cites it in finish() summary).
